title: Snowflake Deal Latest Move into Enterprise Market by OpenAI
content:
# Snowflake 与 OpenAI 的合作是进军企业市场的最新举措
该协议使 OpenAI 能够重新强调其在企业中的模型，并为 Snowflake 提供了一个与众不同的销售点，以吸引客户。
[Esther Shittu](https://aibusiness.com/author/esther-shittu)，新闻撰稿人，AI Business
2026年2月3日
阅读时间：3分钟
![Snowflake 标志的手机图片](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/blt08bff0355e7d0e4a/6982129e7dd7b77f051b3f1a/Snowflake.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Getty Images
OpenAI 与 Snowflake 的多年合作伙伴关系帮助这家生成式 AI 模型制造商将其技术展示给由数据平台提供商服务的不同类别的用户，并表明 AI 模型竞赛已经缩小。
此次合作表明，被视为在向企业提供 AI 产品和服务方面落后的 OpenAI 继续通过与企业平台提供商建立合作关系间接瞄准企业客户。上个月，这家模型制造商透露了与 ServiceNow 的[合作伙伴关系](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-servicenow-enter-into-multiyear-partnership)。
相关文章：[Google 在美国推出低成本 AI Plus 订阅服务](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/google-launches-ai-plus-subscription-us)
### 模型和访问
这笔交易证明了 AI 模型市场的整合，众多参与者开始减少到三个领导者：Google、Anthropic 和 OpenAI。企业级模型的商品化表明，大多数希望吸引客户的平台提供商将寻求与这些供应商建立关系。
“像 Snowflake 这样的公司都在试图通过建立这些合作伙伴关系来在市场上进行差异化竞争，”Gartner 分析师 Arun Chandrasekaran 表示。他补充说，一年前，普遍共识是模型越多越好。SaaS 和平台提供商没有看到与模型制造商特别合作的必要性，因为模型市场仍然开放，但这种情况正在发生变化，导致供应商与关键模型玩家达成协议并将模型集成到他们的技术中。
“这是一种信号，表明我们拥有你想要的东西，更重要的是，我们已经将其紧密集成到我们的产品、平台和你的工作流程中，”Chandrasekaran 说道。
对于 OpenAI 来说，它与 Snowflake 和 ServiceNow 的合作也有助于向 AI 市场重新强调其模型仍然重要且与最初一样有用和可靠，他继续说道。
“OpenAI 正试图通过与许多这些……提供商合作来创建一个广泛的渠道生态系统，以此传达模型中仍有很多价值，并作为一种接触企业客户的方式，”Chandrasekaran 说道。
相关文章：[Microsoft 旨在通过 Maia 200 提高推理效率](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/microsoft-aims-for-better-inference-efficiency)
通过与 Snowflake 的合作，OpenAI 可以接触到新的企业客户和企业内的新角色，因为 Snowflake 的主要关注点一直是数据工程师、数据科学家和业务分析师。相比之下，OpenAI 到目前为止主要关注的是开发者，他补充道。
### 盈利
然而，对于 OpenAI 来说，最大的问题是 Snowflake 将如何补偿使用其模型的 AI 供应商，Omdia（Informa TechTarget 的一个部门）分析师 Mark Beccue 表示。
“是交换计算资源吗？这会是一种循环的东西吗？是许可吗？是收入分成吗？”Beccue 继续说道。“区别在于他们是否得到了报酬？”
虽然 Snowflake 和 OpenAI 已经公布了协议的价值，但尚不清楚这是否包括 [OpenAI 的收入](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-targets-monetization-commitments-2034)。此外，对于 [一家准备上市的公司](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/openai-ipo-know-most-anticipated-174800027.html) 如 OpenAI 来说，这样的交易有所帮助，但并不能解决 OpenAI 的盈利问题，Beccue 补充道。
模型制造商预计 2029 年将是实现盈亏平衡的一年，届时预计收入将达到 1250 亿美元并实现现金流。
“目前全球只有 22 家公司的收入达到或超过 1250 亿美元，”Beccue 说道。
为了实现这一目标，OpenAI 正在放弃其无广告策略，在 ChatGPT 的免费层引入广告，这可能是一种产生现金流的方式，Beccue 继续说道。
相关文章：[OpenAI 目标是到 2034 年实现 1.4 万亿美元的承诺](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-targets-monetization-commitments-2034)
“广告支持的消费者模式是唯一可行的路径，但这并不稳固，”他表示。

# Snowflake Deal Latest Move into Enterprise Market by OpenAI
The agreement allows OpenAI to place renewed emphasis on its models in the enterprise and provides Snowflake with a differentiating selling point for customers.
[Esther Shittu](https://aibusiness.com/author/esther-shittu), News Writer, AI Business
February 3, 2026
3 Min Read
![Pic of Snowflake logo on mobile](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/blt08bff0355e7d0e4a/6982129e7dd7b77f051b3f1a/Snowflake.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Getty Images
OpenAI’s multi-year partnership with Snowflake helps the generative AI model maker put its technology in front of a different category of users served by the data platform provider and show that the AI model race has narrowed.
The partnership shows how OpenAI, seen as behind in the race to deliver AI products and services to businesses, continues to target enterprise customers indirectly by forging relationships with enterprise platform providers. Last month, the model maker revealed a [partnership with ServiceNow](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-servicenow-enter-into-multiyear-partnership).
Related: [Google Launches Low-Cost AI Plus Subscription in the U.S.](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/google-launches-ai-plus-subscription-us)
### Models and Access
The deal is a testament to consolidation in the AI model market, with numerous players starting to winnow to three leaders: Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI. The commoditization of enterprise-ready models indicates that most enterprise platform providers looking to appeal to their customers will seek relationships with these vendors.
“Companies like Snowflake, they’re all trying to build these partnerships as a way to potentially differentiate in the market,” said Arun Chandrasekaran, an analyst at Gartner. He added that a year ago, there was a general consensus that the more models, the better. SaaS and platform providers did not see the need to partner specifically with model makers because the model market was still open, but that is changing, leading vendors to forge deals with key model players and to integrate the models into their technology.
“It’s a way of signaling to the fact that we have what you want, and more importantly, we have tightly integrated that into our product, into our platform and into your workflows,” Chandrasekaran said.
For OpenAI, its partnerships with Snowflake and ServiceNow also help it to reemphasize to the AI market that its models are still important and as useful and dependable as they were in the beginning, he continued.
“OpenAI is trying to create a wide channel ecosystem by partnering with a lot of these … providers as a way to convey that there is still a lot of premium left in the model and also as a way to get access to enterprise customers,” Chandrasekaran said.
Related: [Microsoft Aims for Better Inference Efficiency With Maia 200](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/microsoft-aims-for-better-inference-efficiency)
With the Snowflake partnership, OpenAI gets access to new enterprise customers and new roles within the enterprise since Snowflake's primary focus has been on data engineers, data scientists, and business analysts. In contrast, OpenAI has, up to now, mostly focused on developers, he added.
### Making Money
However, the biggest question for OpenAI is how Snowflake will compensate the AI vendor for using its models, said Mark Beccue, an analyst at Omdia, a division of Informa TechTarget.
“Is it trading compute, which would be some kind of circular thing? Is it licensing? Is it revenue share?” Beccue continued. “Is the difference that they’re getting paid?”
While Snowflake and OpenAI have revealed the value of the agreement, it is unclear whether that is in [revenue for OpenAI](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-targets-monetization-commitments-2034). Moreover, for [a company preparing to go public](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/openai-ipo-know-most-anticipated-174800027.html), such as OpenAI, deals like this help, but they do not resolve OpenAI’s profitability problem, Beccue added.
The model maker projects 2029 to be the year it breaks even, with what it expects as $125 billion in revenue and achieves cash flow.
“Only 22 companies on the planet currently have revenue of $125 billion or more,” Beccue said.
To achieve its goal, OpenAI is shifting away from its no-ad strategy to introduce ads on the free tier of ChatGPT, which might be a way to generate cashflow, Beccue continued.
Related: [OpenAI Targets Monetization, $1.4T Commitments by 2034](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-targets-monetization-commitments-2034)
“Ad-supported consumer is the only viable path, and that's shaky,” he said.
## About the Author
News Writer, AI Business
Esther Shittu brings four years of expertise covering artificial intelligence technologies and industry trends. As co-host of the "Targeting AI" podcast, she talks to thought leaders and practitioners exploring critical AI developments. Previous to AI Business, she wrote for several publications including the New York Daily News, Bklyner and the Brooklyn Daily Eagle. When she's not diving deep into the world of AI, she spends her time on passion projects and raising her three daughters.
